subject: Re: Redwood invoice & procurement next steps (PO vs card / invoice requirements)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tony Ramos <tony.ramos@contoso.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@contoso.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood invoice & procurement next steps (PO vs card / invoice requirements)

Hi Tony / Priya - thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so everything is captured on our side: 

Call recap:
- Product fit: Redwood Dedicated meets Contoso's latency and data isolation needs for the pilot.
- PO vs card: Procurement indicated preference for PO-based procurement but wanted confirmation from Finance.
- Marketplace interest: Tony mentioned AWS Marketplace could speed procurement but needs pricing line items and SKU exposure.
- Billing requirements: we discussed PO#, billing address, remit-to, and tax ID on invoices.

Action items we committed to from Redwood:
1) Send SOW + pricing (attached SOW) and a downloadable invoice template (attached Excel) that includes line-level descriptions and fields for PO#.
2) Provide vendor docs: W-9 and vendor setup form (we will also complete your vendor form).
3) Confirm whether Contoso will raise a PO or pay by corporate card and the billing contact + remit address for invoices.
4) If you want marketplace purchase, we can produce marketplace-ready quoting and confirm SKUs.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood-Contoso_20260803.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx, W-9_RedwoodInc.pdf

Questions for you (short):
- Will Contoso be issuing a PO for the pilot, or should we expect card payments?
- If PO, please confirm the billing contact email and the exact remit/billing address we should use on invoices.
- Any specific invoice level requirements (e.g., separate line items, cost center, tax/VAT note)?

If helpful I can loop in our finance ops (Dylan) to speed vendor setup. Next step on our end: I will send the DocuSign for SOW after we confirm billing path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice & procurement next steps (PO vs card / invoice requirements)

Thanks Marissa - clean summary. A few notes from procurement/finance side: 

- Procurement path: Contoso will proceed with a PO for the initial pilot. We will raise a PO once vendor onboarding is complete.
- Invoice fields: invoice must include Contoso PO number (we will provide on issuance), a line for "Service Description" per month, unit price, quantity, and total. Our AP team needs the PO# printed on the invoice PDF and in the filename (e.g., INV_PO123456.pdf).
- Remit & billing address: Contoso, Attn: Accounts Payable, 100 Enterprise Way, Seattle, WA 98101.
- Tax: US entity; include Redwood's Federal Tax ID on the invoice. No VAT, but we need a completed W-9.
- Vendor onboarding: Please complete our vendor setup form (attached). We also need a copy of Redwood's W-9 and a signed SOW to move forward with PO issuance.

Attachments: Contoso_vendor_setup_form.pdf

One follow-up question: we sometimes prefer Marketplace purchases for smaller items since they bypass vendor onboarding. Can you confirm if the SOW/pricing can be translated into an AWS Marketplace listing or a contract that maps to marketplace SKUs? That would be helpful to know before legal + procurement proceeds.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager | Contoso
priya.singh@contoso.com
[Attachment: Contoso_vendor_setup_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@contoso.com>, Tony Ramos <tony.ramos@contoso.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice & procurement next steps (PO vs card / invoice requirements)

Perfect - thanks for the details Priya. Quick confirmations and next steps from our side:

- I have attached Redwood's W-9 and the SOW we discussed. I will fill out the Contoso vendor setup form and return it by EOD today.
- We will ensure every invoice PDF filename includes the PO# per your example and include line-level descriptions as shown in the attached invoice template.
- Billing contact please confirm: finance@contoso.com or should invoices go to ap@contoso.com? (I want to set the correct recipient in our billing system.)
- Marketplace: yes - we can support an AWS Marketplace offering, but it requires us to publish a marketplace contract and SKU mapping. That process can be faster for procurement in some cases, but it will change how billing is routed (marketplace invoices come from AWS, not Redwood). If Contoso prefers marketplace for the pilot, we can scope that path and produce a marketplace-ready quote; otherwise we'll proceed with direct vendor invoicing.

Next steps (timeline):
1) Today - I will complete and return your vendor setup form + upload W-9.
2) Today - send DocuSign for SOW (link included below) so legal can sign and we can receive a PO.
3) Once PO is issued - operations will schedule the dedicated capacity onboarding.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/s/RDW-SOW-20260803

Thanks - looping in Dylan (finance ops) to make vendor onboarding quick.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: W-9_RedwoodInc.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tony Ramos <tony.ramos@contoso.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice & procurement next steps (PO vs card / invoice requirements)

Marissa - thanks. Confirming: please route invoices to ap@contoso.com (Accounts Payable). We will open the PO once vendor onboarding is complete; expect PO issuance within 5-7 business days after we receive the completed vendor form and signed SOW.

On net terms: standard is Net 30. If Redwood needs Net 45 for initial invoice timing, we can be flexible but prefer Net 30 thereafter.

Marketplace note: we would prefer AWS Marketplace for recurring SaaS if Redwood can publish an offering; procurement will evaluate marketplace vs direct vendor during PO issuance. For now let's proceed with direct vendor billing so onboarding doesn't block the pilot.

Please send the completed vendor form and I will escalate for PO creation.

Thanks,
Tony Ramos
Finance Business Partner | Contoso
tony.ramos@contoso.com
